sections.title: Unit 15: Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Systems & Algorithmic Reason
body: Texts about artificial intelligence need exact words: exceptions (*kivéve, ha*), conditions, degrees of probability and explanations of terms.

This unit follows Neumann János's book *A számítógép és az agy* (1958), which was published after his death. You will learn to read and write about machine learning, language models, explainability, automated decisions and the comparison of the computer and the brain.
